record.definition: unit-size-adjusted median resale $psf, Sep 2021–Sep 2023 against Oct 2024–Sep 2026

text.price: $1,385 psf, the median resale price over the last 24 months (Oct 2024 to Sep 2026).
text.comparison: Resale prices are in line with similar developments in District 16.
text.record: Prices rose 19% between 2021–23 and 2024–26 (adjusted for unit size), against about 17% for developments with similar features in District 16 — about the same as similar developments.
infrastructure: Bayshore MRT, about 160 m (straight line to the nearest exit).
Temasek Primary School, about 900 m: 2.1 applicants per place in Phase 2C, 2025. Admission depends on the exact address.
supply: 2 developments within 2 km are still selling, with about 132 unsold homes (URA developers' sales, Sep 2026).
Land sold for about 380 new homes within 2 km, expected completion 2030.
text.demand: 88 resales in the last 24 months, in 24 of 24 months.
text.answer: Right by an MRT station, a popular primary school within 1 km and a large development. Resale prices are in line with similar developments in District 16.
